t: AI-Powered Excel Mastery: GAPalyzer's Journey to Lightning-Fast Output
s: This article details optimizing GAPalyzer's slow Excel (.xlsx) output using AI (Gemini 3) for strategic refactoring. It covers leveraging `xlsxwriter` for dynamic specialty tabs, optional keyword clustering, and precise rotated header alignment.
sub: AI orchestration for refactoring complex problems
Dynamic Excel tab generation for specialties
